source.origin: Circuit archive nym-auth-circuits.zip (SHA-256 f59a09121369c602b0c9663560ce38ee177f8ada1348389142ae21510862266e) from the SIROS circuit developers; no public repository URL yet

notes: nym_auth age-range plus pseudonym circuit (configuration known-offender-matching-ssc, DST nym_auth/v1/known-offender-matching-ssc). Proves issuer ES256 signature, type, birth_date in [E,C], validity at T, device-key signature over the verifier challenge, SHA-256(secret_seed)=ssc and pseudonym = SHA-256(DST||secret_seed||0x00*32||SHA-256(client_id)). Credentials must follow the issuance profile in the archive's SPEC.md 2.1 (only birth_date and ssc, 16-byte salts, fixed issuer header and claim order). Revocation is not checked. The type constant is baked into the circuit: changing the nym_auth doctype/vct requires new circuits. Artifact: Vega R1CS shapes, zstd of bincode((STEP,CORE)); circuit source is vega/vega-age in the archive.
